sources.role: Standard GM(1,1) and contour extraction source

changes: Portable CLI input/output paths; no private absolute paths or notebook outputs.
Grad-CAM computation preserved; indices default to I1-I6; batch ZIP side effect removed.
Correct layer names are pool3 and pool4 at features[16] and features[23].
Euclidean defaults to LA/PA/SA rather than the abandoned five-model extension.
GM defaults to the numerically stable standard formula, native OpenCV order and periodic cubic display interpolation.
The legacy original GM solver and light display smoothing are explicit options; numerical changes are disclosed.
Experimental residual-corrected cell is not included in the standard GM command.
100 original sample markers are drawn without duplicating the closing point.
